title: Not even worth $4.99
text: Not even worth $4.99. Do you notice in all the photos that the bread is never shown down? That may because the bread doesn't go all the way down. I put in toaster pastries and an inch was left out on top. Set it at the lowest setting and it began burning and I had to fight the handle to get it to pop up and stop. Honestly... I was given this new because my old toaster broke and I needed one fast. She paid $10 for it, but she overpaid by at least $5.01.

product_metadata.title: Proctor Silex 2-Slice Toaster with Shade Selector, Toast Boost, Slide-Out Crumb Tray, Auto-Shutoff and Cancel Button, White (22611)
features: PERFECT TOAST EVERY TIME: Perfectly toast a variety of breads, bagels, English muffins and waffles in this toaster. With extra-wide slots, it will even toast thicker breads like Texas toast and bagels
AUTO SHUTOFF FOR PEACE OF MIND: This 2 slice toaster automatically shuts off at the end of the cycle if toast gets jammed
COMPACT SIZE FITS SMALLER SPACES: The toaster has a compact design to easily fit in smaller spaces and take up less room on the countertop. It's great for small apartments, RVs, and more
EASILY RETRIEVE SMALLER-SIZED BREADS: The Toast Boost feature on this bread toaster lifts smaller breads like English muffins so they're easier to retrieve after toasting
EASY TO CLEAN: Conveniently remove and discard crumbs from the bottom of this small toaster with the drop-down crumb tray, so crumbs don't end up on your countertop
description: Hamilton Beach 2 slice toasters are popular not only for their Expert toasting performance -- they also look great in your kitchen. Wider slots and smart buttons allow you to uniformly toast and warm bagels, English muffins and other breads and advanced toasting technology ensures consistent results with each use.
